result.summary: The tenant replied to our question. They say the clicking is mechanical and comes from the machine itself, so I took that as a plausible answer to whether something loose was in the drum. The issue is routine (appliance, still working) and no landlord approval or spend limit is recorded. I emailed the landlord asking them to approve an engineer's diagnostic visit, and told them any repair cost would come back to them first. I also replied to the tenant, accepting her offer of a video and giving her safe-use advice. Then I put the ticket on hold for 2 days waiting on the landlord.
